course_info.trial_description:
Welcome to Your English Learning Journey!

In this trial lesson, I will introduce you to my teaching approach and the different types of lessons I offer. My teaching style is student-centred, meaning that the lessons are tailored to your needs, interests, and goals. This method emphasises active participation, where you are encouraged to take charge of your learning. Together, we’ll build a supportive environment where you feel comfortable practicing and developing your skills.

Types of Lessons Offered:

Basics for Beginners: If you're just starting out, this lesson focuses on building a strong foundation in English. We cover essential grammar, vocabulary, and pronunciation to help you gain confidence.

Conversation Classes: For those who want to improve their speaking fluency, these sessions are focused on real-life conversations. We’ll practice discussing everyday topics and work on speaking naturally in different contexts.

How to Sound Like a Native Speaker (Advanced): In this advanced class, we explore idiomatic expressions, advanced vocabulary, and natural speech patterns to help you sound more like a native English speaker.

Materials:
The materials I use are varied and engaging to ensure a well-rounded learning experience. This includes articles, videos, audio recordings, and interactive exercises, all chosen to match your level and interests. I also encourage students to bring their own topics or areas they’d like to focus on, allowing us to customise the lessons even further.

In today’s session, we’ll briefly go over some of these materials, and I’ll give you a taste of how each lesson type works. This will help us decide together what fits your learning goals best.

While I specialize in politics, philosophy, literature, and current affairs, I’m also open to discussing a wide range of other topics, making sure the conversation aligns with your interests. pro_course_detail.title: AFRIKAANS Literature Course - DIE KEISER by Bartho Smit
pro_course_detail.description:
Explore the rich narrative of "Die Keiser" by Bartho Smit in this engaging online Afrikaans course. Together, we'll delve into the intricacies of this renowned Afrikaans play, focusing on its compelling dialogue, nuanced character development, and profound themes.

DIE KEISER (The Emperor), is set against the backdrop of 19th-century Cape Colony, and explores themes of power, identity, and moral dilemmas. Written in dialogue form, it follows the gripping story of an emperor who grapples with the consequences of his authoritarian rule and the complexities of human nature. 

Through interactive readings and discussions, you'll gain a deeper appreciation for the literary techniques employed by Smit, and uncover the social and historical context that influenced its creation. 

This course also offers a unique opportunity to enhance your Afrikaans language skills, focusing on pronunciation and vocabulary, while discovering figurative concepts and literary themes. 

Whether you're exploring Afrikaans literature for the first time or seeking a deeper understanding, this course provides a rewarding exploration of "Die Keiser" and its timeless relevance while sharpening your language proficiency.
